title: The Section Formula
summary: Dividing a segment in a given ratio, midpoints and trisection points, and collinearity.
objectives: I can find the point dividing a segment in the ratio m : n.
I can find the ratio in which a point divides a segment.
I can use the distance formula to test shapes.
misconceptions: The section formula is (m x₁ + n x₂)/(m + n).
The midpoint is a special ratio 1 : 2.
